image_description: A male musician with glasses and a black t-shirt is performing on stage, playing a silver electric guitar and singing into a microphone. The background features warm stage lighting, a truss structure, a flag (resembling the US flag but stylized), and large speaker cabinets. A banner with text 'ROCKIN' THE...' is visible on the left.

artifact_observations.location: Left side banner and foreground speaker cabinets
artifact_observations.reasoning: Text on the 'ROCKIN'' banner is partially legible but degrades into nonsense characters. Text on the foreground amplifier/speaker grilles is illegible gibberish, a common AI artifact.
The guitar's headstock appears malformed and fused with the tuning pegs; the neck connection to the body lacks clear structural definition, appearing slightly melted.
Fingers on the fretboard lack distinct separation and appear fused. Guitar strings are faint or missing in sections, blending into the fretboard.
The flag's stripes warp inconsistently with the fabric folds, suggesting slight geometric instability in the texture mapping.

selected_experts.reason: To verify the scene classification as a legitimate concert stage vs. generic room.
To rigorously quantify the illegibility and gibberish nature of the text artifacts.
To check for anatomical correctness of the musician's arms and hands holding the instrument.
To detect fusion between the guitar neck, body, and the musician's hands.
To ensure the overhead lighting rig has valid 3D structure and doesn't melt into the background.

focus_areas: Text legibility on banners and equipment
Coherence of stage lighting truss geometry
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the guitar's headstock and the musician's fingers. AI often fails to render individual strings and distinct fingernails/finger joints correctly. Also, scrutinize the text on the speaker cabinets in the foreground; if it's not crisp brand lettering, it's likely a hallucination.
